registration: Locked before new development collection, training and final testing; local protocol, not external preregistration.
cutoff_definition: Base boundary is strictly before first of two consecutive >5N native samples. Actual offsets vary with 50Hz alignment and are reported. At exact onset boundary the base remains the preceding boundary.
target: Maximum causal 20ms-average positive 20ms-lag load derivative in [native contact onset,onset+40ms), units N/s. Simulator normal-resultant proxy, not hardware truth.
phase_definition: Six frames of unit-circle hip phase proxy atan2(-standardized hip velocity,standardized hip position), four feet, plus current commanded xyz velocity. Hip moments fitted on training only. It is a kinematic proxy, not true gait phase; impact may perturb it.
checkpoint: Fixed final step, no best-test or best-validation selection
matched_strata: Foot x pre_last hip-phase proxy octant x forward command bin ([.4,.525,.65,.775,.9], clipped outside) x terrain family; privileged family used only in evaluation, never model input

primary.comparison: full_BCE minus phase_BCE at post_first on heldout boxes, normal speed
primary.inference: Average two initializations first; paired t 95% CI over five independent data replications. Evidence for practical residual discrimination requires CI lower bound > .03; only one confirmatory superiority endpoint.

secondary: Matched AUC and ordinary AP versus cutoff
Continuous MSE severity RMSE and risk ranking
Contact-event recall at validation-locked weak-contact FPR, not continuous-stream FAR
Validation-only probability calibration and severity-tail error
validation_roles: tile_id modulo 3: 0 probability calibration; 1 threshold choice; 2 independent verification/monitoring. Only training families used for calibration and choice.
scope: Event-aligned supervised observability diagnostic. Ground-truth onset selects examples offline and is not available to deployment. This does not establish a deployable event trigger, continuous-stream FAR, calibrated unknown-domain probabilities, control benefit or hardware prediction.
storage: One raw role staged at a time; preserve compact pre frames, event table, small native audits until scoring then remove bulk pre frames after hashes and weights are archived. Keep event tables, predictions and reports. No previous 220GiB restoration.
